# Proqi 0.13.0

Organize selected Board items together and create named sessions through a more predictable JSON CLI.

## Breaking changes and upgrade

This release upgrades the database to schema 21 and storage protocol 20. Migration creates a backup before applying changes. Older Proqi binaries cannot open the upgraded database. Close older active Proqi sessions cleanly and restart them with the updated executable if they block migration. Do not delete the database or its lock files.

The owner-control protocol advances to 12 for selected cross-session transfers. An older active destination may not accept the new cohort request; restart it with the updated executable before retrying.

The JSON result of `thoughts list` no longer contains a separate `thoughts` array. Read thought entries from `data.items` where `kind` is `thought`; the same ordered array also contains payload-free separators. This is an intentional pre-1.0 compatibility change. The public JSON schema version remains 1.

## Highlights

- Move selected Board items up or down with the existing reorder keys. Each contiguous selected run exchanges with an adjacent unselected item while preserving the selected identities and their relative order. An effective move is one undo step.
- Apply Clean up spacing to selected thoughts as one undoable Board action. Separators remain untouched and an unchanged selection creates no history entry.
- Send all selected thoughts to another Proqi session in Board order. A destination receives the complete cohort before Send and remove deletes any source; an interrupted transfer retains exact retry identities across restart. Separators are not sent.
- When the public API adds the first durable item to an untouched empty Compose board, Proqi enters Board mode and visibly focuses it without opening the text editor. Later API additions do not steal focus.
- Use `sessions ensure` to atomically find or create a named session for an exact directory, `sessions create` to make an additional named session, and `thoughts add --name` to create content and its name in one operation.
- Retry session creation and administration with `--operation-id`, page `sessions list` and `thoughts list` with `--limit` and `--after`, and discover structured error codes through `proqi --json capabilities`. JSON help and version requests now succeed with structured output.

## Known limitations

- The selected transfer cohort and restart-safe source journal apply to TUI Send actions. Scriptable `thoughts send` callers that supply their own operation ID have a separate retry contract; do not assume it inherits the TUI cohort guarantee.
- List pages read current state on each call. Concurrent changes can move entries between pages; a cursor that no longer belongs to the current result reports `cursor_not_found`.
- The underlying terminal-input stall is not fixed by this release. Automatic recovery remains bounded, and an unavailable terminal may require manual session resume.
